rules.common_support: Global intersection for candidates/ranks, all pair metrics and matching evidence; empty support cannot establish a match
rules.omitted_mass: unobserved_mass is posterior mass outside the declared comparison support; it may include variants observed in an individual pair but excluded from the global intersection
rules.source_component_metadata: CS sizes, purity, representatives and entropy resolution describe original fits, without redefining their formal CS
rules.matching: CS-to-CS: overlap OR CS overlap OR representative LD; CS-to-unretained: posterior overlap only, unresolved
rules.component_layer: All active components plus formal CS boundary cases; diffuse overlap is descriptive, not a confirmed split/merge
rules.resolution: Continuous entropy effective-candidate count and fraction; no calibrated binary diffuse threshold
rules.candidates: Union of formal CS members, requested top candidates and PIP-threshold candidates
rules.display: Baseline first; greedy one-to-one formal-CS aid is not evidence of unique signal identity

limitations: PIP across settings is not averaged into a posterior.
CS count and matching relations do not identify an independent causal signal count.
Genotype correlation alone does not establish that two effects are conditionally indistinguishable.

provenance.variant_harmonization: Input order preserved; allele labels unavailable in this toy fixture.
provenance.initial_state: cold start; refinement stage B uses stage A posterior moments
provenance.random_seed: frozen upstream fixture; no new random generation
skipped: gene track: no physical coordinate metadata

fixture.description: Official susieR FinemappingConvergence toy example: a simulated response with real-genotype-derived sufficient statistics. No individual genotypes are included.
fixture.variant_ids: positional indices; genomic positions and alleles not provided

source_identity.note: Source hashes identify the example, refinement tracking and presentation; this record is not a final wheel freeze.

annotations.example_kind: Official susieR FinemappingConvergence toy example: a simulated response with real-genotype-derived sufficient statistics. No individual genotypes are included.
annotations.association_source: Two-sided normal approximation applied to marginal t statistics derived from XtX, Xty and yty (df = n - 2); these are not external GWAS z scores.
annotations.ld_diagnostic_scope: In-sample signed LD r is normalized from the same XtX. Diagnostics use the t-derived statistics with a normal approximation; the near-singular matrix requires the recorded regularization. No flags does not validate an external reference; paired susieR flip-flag agreement was not tested.
report_notes: Official susieR FinemappingConvergence toy example: a simulated response with real-genotype-derived sufficient statistics. No individual genotypes are included.
Component IDs are original zero-based fit rows. Variant IDs are zero-based positional indices; genomic positions, alleles and genome build are unavailable.
PIP, alpha, signed r and displayed r² are unitless. Effect estimates use the scale of the supplied sufficient statistics. CS count is not a causal count.
